newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank cuts special T-bill rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank cuts special T-bill rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had cut the rates of its over-the-counter Treasury bills following the decline in the benchmark 91-day T-bill rate in Monday's auction.
The 85-day special T-bill rate was reduced to 11.45 percent from 11.5 percent, while the 177-day bill rate was cut to 11.75 percent from 11.8 percent.
The special T-bills are being used by the Central Bank as one of the instruments to control liquidity.
The 91-day bellwether T-bill rate went down to 11.526 percent from 11.587 percent at the last auction on Monday.
